name: Price Calculation Method 1 Code
definition: Standard code to specify the method applied for the calculation of the price.

VWAP.name: Volume Weighted Average Price
VWAP.definition: The price is based on a volume-weighted average price which is a ratio of the cumulative share price to the cumulative volume traded over a given time period.

NAVF.name: Final Asset Value
NAVF.definition: Final asset value at the liquidation of the fund.

MIMP.name: Mid Market Price
MIMP.definition: Price at a certain amount of time prior to the date it is announced.

NAVA.name: Net Asset Value
NAVA.definition: Net value of an investment fund's assets less its liabilities, divided by the number of shares outstanding.

AVCL.name: Average Closing Price
AVCL.definition: Price of the asset at close of a given day.
